newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World trade body chief heading for SKorea, China.
newsitem.headline: World trade body chief heading for SKorea, China.

text.p: World Trade Organisation (WTO) Director-General Renato Ruggiero will visit South Korea next week for talks with government officials before travelling on to China, trade sources said on Monday.
They said Ruggiero would spend three days in Seoul from April 14-17.
His already announced visit to China, during which he will discuss the current state of Beijing's decade-long bid for admission to the WTO with government leaders, will be from April 18-24.

The WTO Secretariat, which Ruggiero heads, has no powers of its own to admit China to the organisation, which now has 130 members. Entry of new countries is decided by the entire membership by consensus.
